from.name: Linux TCP_INFO / struct tcp_info observability ABI

property: Linux exposes two different operational state planes: TCP_INFO/ss for live per-socket transport state, and tcp_metrics/ip tcp_metrics for destination-keyed learned state remembered across connections.

date_or_range.notes: The interfaces coexist because they answer different operational questions.

negative_claims: `ss -ti` and `ip tcp_metrics` are not two front ends for the same state object.
Cached RTT/cwnd-related destination memory must not be mistaken for the instantaneous state of any one socket.
open_questions: Create a reproducible lab showing one live TCP_INFO sample beside persistent tcp_metrics state before and after connection close.
